method: PageSpeed Insights UI, mobile Lighthouse 13.5.0, Moto G Power, slow 4G, initial navigation. One successful lab run per URL; not a before/after comparison. Anonymous PSI API returned 429; UI reports succeeded after retrying catalog/recipe navigation.

field_data.scope: origin https://cook-look.ru, PHONE; URL-level data unavailable
field_data.period: Last 28 days displayed on 2026-10-16; exact collection bounds not exposed in the inspected view
field_data.limitation: INP is displayed as a dash, not zero. Do not claim all three CWV were measured or attribute these pre-release data to local changes.

local_browser.limitation: Responsive geometry and interactions, not throttled mobile performance measurements.

structured_data_validators.limitation: Vocabulary validation does not establish culinary truth or rich-result eligibility. Production still has the old separate Recipe/WebSite.

structured_data_validators.result: Connected WebPage graph including Recipe: no errors, no warnings.
structured_data_validators.limitation: External validator did not crawl the local page or its local images.

structured_data_validators.limitation: The form remained visible after submission in both modes; no result report was returned in this session. Not counted as passed.
